::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [March 1836]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  This fragment printed by Coleridge, <i>[Life](other_books/otherbook_40.qmd)</i>, 124.
:::

One of the things I have to do for [M. de Normanville](people/person_1088.qmd)[^1] is to write a story in French, and [my story](cmy_books/cmybook_1.qmd) goes on for ever and ever . . .  my poor little girls meet with all sorts of dangers.

---

[^1]: F. de Normanville (b. 1770/1), her French and Italian teacher, an émigré from the French Revolution.
